title: Oh Honey
cn: 第 15 集 · 哦,亲爱的
novel: Zoey decided to fix Ted up with her [[cousin|cousin]], a woman known as Honey. Honey was [[sweet|sweet]] but incredibly naive. She believed everything people told her and never seemed to [[question|question]] anything. The gang started calling her Oh Honey because they felt both [[affection|affection]] and pity for her. Ted went on a date with Honey but could not stop thinking about Zoey. He [[pretended|pretend]] to be interested in Honey's stories, but his mind was [[elsewhere|elsewhere]]. Meanwhile, the gang pieced together the story of how Ted and Zoey had been spending time together. They used Honey as a sounding board, and she [[innocently|innocent]] revealed details that Ted had been hiding. It became clear that Ted had developed strong feelings for Zoey. The gang confronted Ted and told him he needed to be honest with himself. Ted had an [[epiphany|epiphany]] about his true feelings for Zoey. He realized that he was in love with her and that he had been for some time. The [[realization|realization]] hit him like a wave. He knew that loving a married woman was [[wrong|wrong]], but he could not help how he felt. He decided to [[confess|confess]] his feelings to Zoey, even though it might ruin their friendship. Zoey listened to Ted's confession with tears in her eyes. She [[admitted|admit]] that she felt the same way. They agreed to be together, but only after Zoey had officially [[separated|separate]] from The Captain. Honey, meanwhile, went on a date with Barney, who tried to [[deceive|deceive]] her with his usual tricks. But Honey was so innocent that she actually saw through his [[nonsense|nonsense]] and called him out on it. Barney was stunned and [[intrigued|intrigue]]. For the first time, he wondered if a woman like Honey might be exactly what he needed.

cousin.en: a child of your aunt or uncle

sweet.en: kind and gentle in a pleasant way

affection.en: a feeling of liking and caring for someone

pretend.en: to act as if something is true when it is not

innocent.en: in a way that shows no awareness of harm

realization.en: the moment you understand something clearly

wrong.en: not correct or not morally right

confess.en: to admit something you have been hiding

admit.en: to agree that something is true

separate.en: to move apart or end a relationship

deceive.en: to make someone believe something false

nonsense.en: words or ideas that are silly or untrue

intrigue.en: to make someone very curious and interested
